name: chatgpt-workspace-mcp
description: Discover approved Git and non-Git projects, safely edit and test them, and use guarded Git delivery when available.

interface.shortDescription: 从 ChatGPT 安全查看、修改和提交本地项目。
interface.longDescription: 通过 Secure MCP Tunnel 将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 连接到本地批准的 Git 或非 Git 项目。支持项目发现、SHA-256 保护的修改与删除、白名单任务；Git 项目还支持显式路径提交、敏感内容扫描和可选受控推送。不暴露任意 Shell 或强制推送。
defaultPrompt: List the local projects I have authorized.
Discover an approved project, make the requested change, run its tests, show the diff, and commit only selected files.
